subject.title: fix: stop retrying stale mercadolibre price updates

question: Should this PR land with the global `MARK_INACTIVE` retry-field cleanup and per-failed-price-update MercadoLibre status lookup, or should it be narrowed or proven further first?
rationale: The code path is a high-volume marketplace cron and the PR changes persisted marketplace state; automation cannot decide the acceptable rollout risk without owner intent and real operational proof.

options.title: Require proof and owner approval
options.body: Ask for a redacted live run/log showing stale listings becoming `INACTIVE`, then let the MercadoLibre owner approve the global state mutation before merge.

options.title: Accept monitored rollout
options.body: Merge with explicit owner sign-off and monitor MercadoLibre cron duration, API errors, and remaining `UPDATING_PRICE` rows without requiring more contributor proof.

options.title: Narrow before merge
options.body: Change the implementation so retry-field cleanup is scoped to the MercadoLibre stale-listing path instead of changing all `MARK_INACTIVE` callers.

recommendation.title: Require proof and owner approval
recommendation.body: Ask for a redacted live run/log showing stale listings becoming `INACTIVE`, then let the MercadoLibre owner approve the global state mutation before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Marcos has the strongest recent MercadoLibre hardening history and was explicitly requested for this review in the PR discussion.
